newsitem.title: USA: Community Investors sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Community Investors sets stock split.

text.p: Community Investors Bancorp Inc said Tuesday it adopted a three-for-two stock split to shareholders of record on June 27.
Community Investors Bancorp also said it has received authorization by its board to apply to the Office of Thrift Supervision (OTS) to buy back an additional 5 percent of its outstanding stock.
As a result of the announced stock split and anticipated approval from the OTS, 47,470 shares would be purchased and placed in treasury, the company said.
